text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P12345 — p99 latency exceeded for /v1/generate in eu-west. current p99=2.6s (threshold=1.2s). Auto-pager invoked and notifications sent. Severity: high. Links: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345

Anjali: Acked. I'm starting triage. Any customer-facing impact yet?

Mike: Seeing a KV-cache eviction spike on aux-cache-03, eviction rate up 8x in last 2m. QPS about normal.

Ben: Noted. I'm going to drain background batch jobs on eu-west nodes to free mem.

Anjali: Doing a quick model fallback to rwd-small-v2 for 10% of traffic in eu-west to test latency reduction.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary deploy started: model-fallback -> rwd-small-v2 (10%). No errors so far.

Sara: Re-routing 20% of traffic to eu-north as a temporary regional fallback. Will watch p99 there.

Mike: Cache warmup looks poor after recent rollout; cold misses causing CPU spike on tokenizers. Increasing tokenizer worker concurrency on aux-cache-03.

Anjali: Good. Ben — confirm batchers paused?

Ben: Batchers paused (cmd: `kubectl scale deployment batcher --replicas=0 -n eu-west`).

Anjali: PD incident P12345 annotated with mitigation steps. Can we estimate customer impact?

Mike: Based on logs, 3% of requests saw >1.5s extra latency. Most are non-critical background calls, but a handful of interactive sessions in region reported slow responses.

Sara: I'll draft a short status note for customer success: "We observed elevated latency in eu-west; we've routed traffic and applied fallbacks. No data loss. Further updates in 30m."

Anjali: Monitoring: p99 dropped to 1.3s in canary group, overall p99 trending down to 1.8s. Keep throttles and routing for 10 more minutes.

eng-runtime-bot: Alert suppression enabled for duplicate p99 alerts for 5m to avoid paging storm.

Mike: Eviction rate dropped after throttle + fallback, KV hit rate improving.

Ben: Batchers remain paused. I'll start a controlled resume once p99 stabilizes under 1.3s for 3 consecutive 1m windows.

Anjali: Thanks team. Oncall handover note: if p99 creeps back above 1.5s, escalate to eng-runtime and paging to SRE lead.

Sara: Status note posted to #customer-status and pinned to incident.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by Anjali. Incident P12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

Anjali: Closing loop — we'll leave fallbacks and routing in place for 30m, then revert if stable and follow up with a postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
